LightingSTANDARD

Perimeter shadow-line LED cove

SUGGESTED SPECIFICATION

A 50 mm dropped plasterboard ceiling with an aluminium shadow-gap cove profile, 24 V / 2700 K COB LED strip (14.4 W/m) and a remote driver.

HOW TO IMPLEMENT IT

Prepare a flat ceiling, then frame a perimeter pocket set back 50–80 mm from the walls. Fit the LED extrusion and diffuser into the trough, run 24 V wiring to an accessible driver, and finish the plasterboard edge to the trim bead.

What changes

A recessed profile conceals the light source and creates the continuous ceiling glow.
